description: Read one section named in a manifest, in full: give unitid for a section of a school's policy (from playlist_policy_open), or checklist_id for a section of a checklist's playlist (from playlist_open). A section over 60,000 characters is returned in parts: the answer carries part and next_part, and you ask again with part set to next_part until next_part is null. Pages come in cleaned text, the same text every source quote is checked against. With unitid, section page:<capture_file> reads any capture held for the school, such as one playlist_find_pages found, not only the pages the manifest lists. Read-only.

checklist_id.description: The checklist whose playlist section to read; give this or unitid, not both

part.description: Optional: which part of a long section, from 1 (default 1)

section.description: The section's name exactly as the manifest gives it

unitid.description: The school whose policy section to read; give this or checklist_id, not both

name: playlist_read
title: Playlist Read
